newsitem.title: USA: Unigene gets $6 mln from Warner-Lambert.
newsitem.headline: Unigene gets $6 mln from Warner-Lambert.

text.p: Unigene Laboratories Inc said on Monday that it received $6 million from Warner-Lambert Co for oral calcitonin, and foresees potential peak-year revenues of $200 million from this product used for treating osteoporosis.

Unigene also said in a news release that its licensing agreement entitled it to an additional $48.5 million in milestone payments from Warner-Lambert, $15.5 million of which is to be received before the Phase 1 study begins.
Unigene said it also is to receive revenue from the sale of raw material to Warner-Lambert, and royalties on product sales.

"If our oral calcitonin product reaches its full potential, Unigene could realize peak-year revenue from raw material supply and royalties that exceed $200 million," Unigene President Warren Levy said in the release.
Unigene retains worldwide licensing rights to injectible and nasal forms of calcitonin.
